hints.content:
Louise starts with earning $\$\blueE{25}$ for mowing a neighbor's yard.

$\$\blueE{25}$

Then she earns $\$\tealE{75}$ for mowing more yards.

$\$\blueE{25} + \$\tealE{75}$

She did this for $\maroonE{5}$ weeks, so we multiply the expression by $\maroonE{5}$. To show that we are multiplying the whole expression by $\maroonE{5}$, we can put the expression $\blueE{25} + \tealE{75}$ in parentheses.

$\maroonE5\times(\blueE{25} + \tealE{75})$

This tells us that everything inside the parentheses is being multiplied by $\maroonE{5}$.
At the end of the $\maroonE5$ weeks, she spent $\$\purpleE{250}$, so we will subtract $\purpleE{250}$ from $\maroonE5\times(\blueE{25} + \tealE{75})$.

question.content:
Louise earned $\$25$ by mowing a neighbor's yard. She mowed a few more yards and earned an additional $\$75$. She mowed all of the same yards each week for a total of $5$ weeks, earning money at the same rate. At the end of the $5$ weeks, she spent $\$250$. 
 
**Which numerical expression shows the amount of money Louise has left?**   

[[☃ radio 1]]
